notes.title: Demo release notes
notes.content:
Today there is a small patch for the demo.

[list]
[*] updated how to play window to fit smaller screens
[*] fix an issue when sometimes traps could despawn on restart
[*] fix an issue when sometimes skills were missing at the end of a level after restart
[/list]

Thanks everyone for the support so far. Let us know if you are having any issues.

Regards
Mike

notes.title: Demo available now!
notes.content:
The focus of the demo is to show people how a game like Lemmings used to work. Plus highlight some of the additions made to the format in our game.

Demo caps at level 5 and has limited skills to pickup. There is only one additional wizard type to unlock which you'll find just randomly by completing a stage. As to different environments there is 3 types of it to go through. With their own traps and enemies to deal with.

We'll keep updating the demo with new interesting features down the road as a sneak peak to the full game.

As of now I hope you enjoy the experience and please let us know if you have any ideas or issues you encounter.

Regards
Mike

notes.title: Roadmap
notes.content:
I think it's only fair to let everyone know the plan regarding upcoming events and release dates.

The plan is to have a demo ready just before the October Next Fest. That part is almost done; we're currently making sure it's stable and fun to play. The mission for the demo is to explain the basics of how a game like Lemmings used to work, in case someone isn't as old as I am and doesn't know what that game was about :). We'll also highlight some of the new features added. We haven't set an exact date yet, but it should be available a couple of weeks before Next Fest.

As for the rest of the game, we'll see what the vibe is after the demo is out and evaluate how much work is left to do. Ideally, we aim to release the full game by the end of 2024. At the moment, a fair bit of the game has already been implemented, as it's been in development for quite some time. This is the phase where I need to ensure that everything works and is enjoyable. So, there will be a lot of tweaking and adding more fun elements to it.

That's about it. I just wanted to let people know when and what's happening.

Thank you for coming to my TED Talk.

Mike
